extracted.name: Aloo mutter tikki
extracted.description: Great recipe for Aloo mutter tikki.
instruction_lines: Mash potatoes in bowl, add pinch of salt to it. Keep a side
Now heat the pan add 2/3 spoons of oil to it
Add ginger,garlic,chilli paste as per taste
Add carrot to it now mash boiled green peas add to the pan
Mix well add lemon juice and salt according to taste
Take potato batter add maida and breadcrumbs to it
Take small ball of batter, stuff above mentioned stuffing of peas and carrot.
Heat pan and shallow fry tikkis, serve hot with pudina chutney or sauce. Kids love it.😊😊😊
